question: I need a bigger size of the same jacket model for a domestic order. The current price went up. What price applies, and how long is an approved replacement held?

searches.query: I need a bigger size of the same jacket model for a domestic order. The current price went up. What price applies, and how long is an approved replacement held?

chunks.text: Exchanging a size or color  For a domestic order, an eligible unused product can be exchanged for a different size or color of the same model. The exchange keeps the original paid item price even if the current listing price changed. The replacement must be available when the request is approved. Exchanges into a different model are handled as a return followed by a new purchase at the new model's price.  The warehouse holds an approved replacement for seven calendar days. The customer must hand the returning parcel to the carrier within that period. The hold does not last until the parcel physically arrives at the warehouse. If the dispatch deadline passes, the reservation is released and availability must be checked again. Support cannot promise stock from a catalog description.  Exchanges use the same unused-condition and eligibility-window rules as standard returns. The store does not offer direct international exchanges. An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order.

A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values. An ordinary exchange for the same model in a different size follows the exchange-price rule instead. Do not treat a size exchange as a second price adjustment.

Price adjustments after a purchase  If the store lowers the price of the identical model, size, and color within seven calendar days of an online purchase, the purchaser may request one price adjustment. The lower-priced item must be available to buy when the request is made. A price on another retailer's website does not qualify. A different color or size is not an identical item for this policy.  Final-sale outlet items, bundle promotions, gift-card purchases, and one-use personalized coupons are excluded. The adjustment returns the eligible price difference to the original payment method after approval. It does not change the original order date, extend the return window, or remove a product's shipping restrictions.  Support needs the original purchase record and the current matching listing to decide a live request. These policy documents contain the rule, not today's product prices or inventory. A customer asking for the exact difference on a particular order needs those live values.

This trial changes the eligibility window and acceptable wear for hiking boots only. It does not change the price of a return label. Read the return-label policy for the applicable fee and the membership policy for any shipping benefits. The fit trial does not promise a particular replacement model will be in stock.

Standard returns for unused gear  The online store accepts ordinary unused gear within 30 calendar days after delivery. Customers must open a return request in the order portal before that window ends. After approval, they have seven calendar days to hand the parcel to the carrier. The request date determines whether the return was opened on time; the carrier acceptance date determines whether the shipping deadline was met.  Keep the original tags attached and include all parts. Trying a jacket on indoors does not count as using it. Washing a garment, taking a sleeping bag camping, or removing a safety seal does count as use. Used products cannot enter the ordinary change-of-mind return process. Hiking boots have a separate fit-trial policy, and damaged products have a separate warranty process. An exception for one product category does not extend the window for other products in the same order.  The warehouse checks the condition before approving the refund. A return request is not itself a refund.

An international customer may use the return route if eligible and place a separate new order. Import taxes and international return transport are covered in the international-orders article. Exchange approval does not automatically waive a return-label fee.

Returning a gift  A recipient with a gift receipt can return eligible unused gear within 45 calendar days after delivery. The recipient receives store credit equal to the item's paid price. The recipient does not receive a refund to their own bank card. If the purchaser requests the return through their original order, the normal purchaser-refund rules apply instead.  A gift receipt hides the price on the paper presented to the recipient, but the order system still records the actual amount paid. Discounts are included in that amount. For a product bought as part of a discounted bundle, use the bundle-allocation policy to calculate the paid amount for that product. Do not substitute the current shelf price, the pre-discount price, or the price of a replacement item.  Gift returns still require an approved request and must meet the condition requirements. The gift window does not make a used jacket returnable. The return-label fee follows the ordinary return-label policy.

Oversize delivery for kayaks and cargo boxes  Kayaks and rigid roof cargo boxes are oversize products. Delivery to an eligible address in the contiguous United States costs USD 35 per order containing oversize items. Neither the ordinary free-shipping threshold nor the membership threshold waives this fee. Adding a small accessory to the order does not turn the oversize shipment into an ordinary parcel.  Oversize deliveries use a scheduled ground carrier. Express parcel service is not available for these products. The carrier contacts the customer to arrange an appointment after the shipment is ready. The documentation does not provide a fixed appointment date for any particular order. Support must check the live shipment record before discussing an actual delivery appointment.  At delivery, inspect the outer packaging before signing and photograph visible transport damage. If damage is discovered afterward, use the delivery-damage reporting policy. Store pickup may be available for an oversize item when the chosen store has stock.

Store membership benefits  An active annual membership costs USD 24 and lasts 12 months from purchase. Members receive the lower standard-delivery threshold described in the shipping-price policy and can join the equipment-repair queue with priority handling. Priority handling changes the queue position; it does not make the repair free or guarantee a completion date.  Membership does not waive return-label charges, express-delivery charges, oversize-delivery charges, or repair prices. It does not extend the standard return window or the boot fit-trial window. A customer who has both a membership and an eligible product-specific benefit can use those benefits under their separate rules. Support should state which benefit applies rather than calling all shipping or returns free.  Benefits start when membership is activated. Orders placed before activation retain their original delivery charges. A membership is attached to one customer account and cannot be shared across unrelated accounts. The policy explains the benefits and annual duration; it does not reveal a particular customer's current membership status.
